# Leeway Rides

> Leeway Rides (LTS Connect Network Inc.) provides pre-scheduled transportation in Shelby and Western North Carolina: non-emergency medical transportation (ambulatory), rides to work, airport transportation, school transportation, and personal trips. All rides are scheduled in advance and confirmed by a human dispatcher before the trip.

## Contact
- Phone (call or text): 980-470-7973
- Website: https://leewayrides.com
- Service areas: Shelby, Kings Mountain, Gastonia, Forest City, Charlotte, and surrounding Western North Carolina communities

## Services
- Airport transportation (Charlotte Douglas CLT, Greenville-Spartanburg GSP, Asheville AVL): https://leewayrides.com/pages/airport-transportation.html
- Non-emergency medical transportation: https://leewayrides.com/pages/medical-transportation.html
- Daily and weekly work transportation: https://leewayrides.com/pages/work-transportation.html
- Shelby and Cleveland County transportation: https://leewayrides.com/pages/shelby-transportation.html
- Gastonia transportation: https://leewayrides.com/pages/gastonia-transportation.html
- Transportation partnerships and subcontracting: https://leewayrides.com/pages/partners.html

## How to book
- Request a quote online at https://leewayrides.com (Quick Quote form)
- Talk to Hey Lee, the Leeway Rides voice assistant: https://leewayrides.com/hey-lee.html
- Call or text dispatch at 980-470-7973
- A booking request is not a confirmed reservation; dispatch contacts every customer to confirm the ride and price.
